scope: Evidence review before any Home Village Super Minion Long Shot behavior is enabled.

sources.title: Super Minion Fires a LONG SHOT!
sources.finding: Official video description establishes that the first attacks have longer range and extra damage, and that Super Minions can trigger Seeking Air Mines.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
sources.finding: All Super Minion levels received about 15% damage; Long Range Shots increased from 7 to 8 and range increased from 10 to 10.25 tiles.

sources.title: Pinned normalized Minion superTroop payload
sources.finding: Pinned payload retains base range 4, one-second cadence and current per-level ordinary damage, but no Long Shot count, range, damage multiplier, projectile or target-retention fields.

established: Super Minion is an in-scope flying Home Village Super Troop whose opening attacks have longer range and extra damage.
The January 2026 official balance note changes the current opening sequence to eight Long Range Shots at 10.25 tiles.
The ordinary payload's one-second cadence and per-level damage remain separately provenance-tracked, but cannot establish the Long Shot modifier.
unresolved: No public official source gives the numerical extra-damage multiplier, whether it changes with level, or whether the approximate all-level damage buff applies before or after it.
No source defines whether the eight-shot counter is per deployment, per target, reset on target loss, interrupted by movement, or consumed by a cancelled/invalid projectile.
No source defines Long Shot projectile speed, homing/target-loss behavior, attack-delay boundary, collision geometry, altitude filtering, size-aware range measurement or visual timing.
decision: Superseded by th18-2026-09-18-super-minion.json: Core, GUI and RL now expose the primary-sourced eight-shot 10.25-tile opening range with an explicit ordinary-damage lower-bound fallback. This audit remains the evidence record for the unresolved multiplier and counter lifecycle.
